signatures (every public export and the types it is made of)
  ALLOWED_IMAGE_MEDIA_TYPES (packages/ui-sdk/src/protocol.ts)
    const ALLOWED_IMAGE_MEDIA_TYPES: readonly ["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/gif"];
  API_FAILURE_DETAIL (packages/ui-sdk/src/testing/index.ts)
    const API_FAILURE_DETAIL: "model not supported by this runtime";
  ASK_ANSWER_UPDATE_REQUIRED (packages/ui-sdk/src/protocol.ts)
    const ASK_ANSWER_UPDATE_REQUIRED: "ASK_ANSWER_UPDATE_REQUIRED";
  ASK_RECEIPTS_CAPABILITY (packages/ui-sdk/src/protocol.ts)
    const ASK_RECEIPTS_CAPABILITY: "askReceipts";
  ASK_USER_CONTRACT (packages/ui-sdk/src/tool-contracts/bridge.ts)
    const ASK_USER_CONTRACT: import("./contract.js").ToolComponentContract<"ask_user", z.ZodObject<{
        questions: z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
            header: z.ZodString;
            multiSelect: z.ZodBoolean;
            options: z.ZodArray<z.ZodObject<{
                description: z.ZodString;
                label: z.ZodString;
                preview: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>;
            }, z.core.$strip>>;

  ASK_USER_FORM_DESCRIPTION (packages/ui-sdk/src/tool-contracts/form.ts)
    const ASK_USER_FORM_DESCRIPTION: "Ask related conditional questions in one editable card. Supply a flat nodes list of single, multi, scale, rank or short text questions. showIf references only an earlier single/multi node and matches its offered option labels. Hidden answers never appear in the result; visibleNodes distinguishes skipped from hidden. Host defaults: depth 3, 12 nodes, 8 options (configurable). Scale: 1-30 items, 2-8 options; rank: 2-15 items. For independent questions use ask_user; for one list use ask_user_list or ask_user_rank. Never use this for permission prompts.";

  BRAIN_UI_SYSTEM_PROMPT_APPEND (packages/ui-sdk/src/server/system-prompt.ts)
    const BRAIN_UI_SYSTEM_PROMPT_APPEND: "# Response surface\n\nYour replies render as GitHub-flavored markdown in a chat UI, not in a\nterminal. What that buys you:\n\n- **Diagrams.** A ```mermaid fence renders as a real diagram, themed to match\n  the app. The reader can open it full-screen to pan and zoom, and share it as\n  PNG, PDF or SVG. Reach for one when structure IS the answer — a flow, a\n  sequence, a state machine, a hierarchy, a timeline — instead of describing\n  the shape in prose. Available types include flowchart, sequence, class,\n  state, ER, journey, gantt, pie, quadrant, mindmap, timeline, gitGraph,\n  sankey, xychart, block, requirement, kanban and architecture; most answers\n  that want a picture are not flowcharts. Keep it to what fits on a phone: a\n  handful of nodes with short labels beats one exhaustive diagram. Prose,\n  lists and tables remain the default for everything non-structural.\n- **Do not put a `%%{init}%%` directive in a diagram.** The app themes every\n  diagram itself, and your own directive silently overrides that theme and\n  makes the diagram look foreign. Write plain mermaid.\n- **Diagrams stream.** A partial fence shows as source until it parses, so a\n  diagram mid-answer costs the reader nothing.\n- **Paths and wikilinks are tap targets.** A repo path written plainly\n  (`projects/active/foo.md`) becomes a link into the file viewer, and\n  `[[note]]` / `[[note|Label]]` resolves the same way. Wikilinks are also\n  what the graph view is built from, so when you WRITE a note, link it to its\n  neighbours — an unlinked note is invisible in the graph.\n- **No raw HTML.** The renderer has no HTML pass, so `<b>x</b>` reaches the\n  reader as the literal text `<b>x</b>`, tags and all. Markdown only — the\n  one exception is the share block below.\n- Tables, task lists and footnotes render; code blocks are highlighted and\n  copyable.\n\n# Shareable output\n\nWhen the user asks for something to send onward (\"summarize this for\nWhatsApp\", \"make a one-pager I can email\"), wrap the shareable part:\n\n<share format=\"image\" title=\"Weekly summary\">\nmarkdown body — rendered as a preview and used as the share payload\n</share>\n\n`format` pre-fills the primary button: image | pdf | text | markdown |\nrichtext. Use it only when sharing was actually asked for; every assistant\nmessage already carries its own share button.\n\nThe PNG/PDF renderer runs with no network and no JavaScript, so **remote\nimages do not appear** — inline anything essential as a `data:` URI. Mermaid\ndiagrams are the exception and always render.\n\nOnly files inside the brain repo can be opened, previewed or shared from the\nUI. Anything you write to /tmp or elsewhere is invisible to the reader. For\noutput that is only for now (a preview, a draft, a file to share and forget),\nuse the brain's scratch area, `.brain/scratch/` (`brain render --scratch`,\n`brain image --scratch`). Scratch is hidden from normal file-tree browsing;\ngive the reader a direct chat link to the exact repo-relative output path\nreturned by the command, including its leading dot, for preview or download.\nScratch files are never committed and are pruned after 7 days.\n\n# Working in the open\n\n- **Don't narrate tool use.** Every call is already shown with its inputs,\n  outputs and duration in a timeline the reader can expand. \"Let me read that\n  file\" is noise; the finding is the message.\n- **Approvals cost a tap**, sometimes while the reader is walking. Batch\n  related edits; don't split work into a long chain of small approvals.";

    export type BackendActivityEvent = {
        kind: "autonomous_identity";

        backendId: string;
        profileId?: string;
    } | {
        kind: "subagent_started";

        kind: "subagent_status";

        };

    } | {

        role: "assistant" | "user";
        text: string;
    } | {
        kind: "permission_denied";

        requestKind: "tool" | "command";
        reason: string;
    } | {
        kind: "runtime_observed";
        runtime?: {
            name: string;
            version: string;
        };
        sdk?: {
            name: string;
            version: string;
        };
        credential?: Record<string, string>;
        billing: BillingMode | "unknown";
        policy?: BillingMode;
        policyViolation?: string;
        measured?: boolean;
    } | {
        kind: "auth_failure";
        errorClass: string;
        message?: string;
    };

    }, z.core.$strict>], "kind">;
